rationale: John brings hands-on cloud infrastructure expertise (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a conviction that data-driven organizations win, while Geetika ships cloud products at AWS as a Senior Technical Product Manager—making them natural collaborators on how infrastructure meets real developer needs. John's community leadership at Code and Coffee and focus on agentic AI align well with the developer-tools and AI-applications space Geetika operates in, creating potential for mentorship exchange and product feedback loops.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Geetika Mehta — you both work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and developer tools, and John's perspective on zero-downtime deployment practices and data infrastructure could be valuable input for the products you're shipping at AWS.
